items.title: 15.9 Crystals se X-rays ka diffraction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation, paragraph for paragraph with the English (book) lesson.

blocks.text: X-rays bhi electromagnetic radiation hain, lekin in ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m. Diffraction dekhne ke liye grating spacing istemal hone wali radiation ki wavelength ke order (taqreeban usi size) ki honi chahiye. Crystal mein atoms ki regular (ba-qaida, aik jaisi) arrangement aik natural (qudrati) diffraction grating ban jati hai jis ki spacing aam taur par taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m hoti hai. Crystal lattice (atoms ka jaal) ke atoms se X-rays ki scattering (har taraf bikharna) bilkul waise hi diffraction effects deti hai jaise aam grating par visible roshni deti hai.

Crystals ki atomic structure (banawat) ki X-rays se study W.H. Bragg aur W.L. Bragg ne shuru ki (kitab saal 1914 likhti hai) aur bari kamyabiyan hasil keen. Unhon ne dekha ke monochromatic (aik wavelength wali) X-rays ki beam crystal plane se aise reflect hoti hai jaise mirror (aaine) se. Yeh samajhne ke liye crystal ki surface ke parallel atomic planes (atoms ki tahon) ka set lein jin ka darmiyani faasla (interplanar spacing) d barabar hai; Fig. 15.18 mein yeh lines PP′, P₁P′₁, P₂P′₂ waghaira hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 9.18' ka reference deti hai; atomic planes PP′, P₁P′₁, P₂P′₂ Fig. 15.18 mein dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Crystal mein d faasle par atomic planes PP', P1P1' aur P2P2', jaal ke points par atoms. X-ray rays I aur II theta angle par parti hain; I oopar wali plane ke point A par aur II agli plane ke point C par, jo A ke bilkul neeche hai, reflect hoti hai. A se dashed perpendicular lines ray II ko B aur B' par milti hain; laal hisse BC aur CB' har aik d sin theta hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.18: Crystal se X-rays ka diffraction (kitab ki Figure 15.18 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Interesting Application
blocks.text: Kitab radio waves ka diffraction dikhati hai: radio waves pahari ke kinare se mur kar us ke peeche ke gharon tak pohanch jati hain, kyunke un ki wavelength bohat lambi hai (pahari ke size ke qareeb).

blocks.alt: Radio waves seedhi khari wavefronts (lehron ki lakeeron) ki shakal mein baen taraf se (teer) pahari ki taraf aati hain. Pahari ki choti se aage wavefronts mur kar pahari ke peeche neeche ki taraf jati hain, jahan ghar hain; pahari ke saamne wali taraf darakht hain.
blocks.caption: Diffraction of radio waves: radio waves ka pahari ke gird mur jana (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Maan lein X-rays ki beam kisi plane par angle θ se parti hai. Beam atoms ki oopar wali aur neeche wali dono planes se reflect ho sakti hai. Neeche wali plane se reflect hone wali beam oopar wali plane se reflect hone wali beam ke muqable mein kuch extra faasla tay karti hai. Dono reflected beams ka asal path difference 2d sin θ hai (Fig. 15.18 mein d sin θ jate hue aur d sin θ wapas aate hue). Is liye reinforcement (mazboot hona, yani roshan nishan) ke liye path difference wavelength ka poora number guna hona chahiye:

n ko order of reflection (reflection ka number) kehte hain. Equation 15.8 ko Bragg equation kehte hain. Agar maloom wavelength ki X-rays crystal se diffract karwayi jayen to is equation se crystal ki aik jaisi parallel planes ka darmiyani faasla d nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Kitab do photos dikhati hai: 100 slits wali grating aur 2000 slits wali grating se white (safed) roshni ka spectrum. 2000 slits wali grating ke spectrum mein rang zyada saaf aur alag alag nazar aate hain, kyunke zyada slits se maxima patle aur sharp hote hain.

X-ray diffraction biology ke ahem molecules ki structure maloom karne mein bohat faidamand raha hai, jaise haemoglobin (jo khoon ka ahem hissa hai) aur DNA ki double helix (do dhaagon wali ghumawdar seerhi jaisi) structure.
Hal shuda misal (worked example) (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: 1.54 × 10⁻¹⁰ m wavelength ki X-rays aik crystal se 15.9° ke glancing angle (plane aur ray ke darmiyan angle) par first-order reflection deti hain. Planes ka darmiyani faasla d maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: λ = 1.54 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, θ = 15.9°, n = 1; maloom karna hai d.
Bragg equation: 2d sin θ = nλ, is liye d = nλ/(2 sin θ)

blocks.prompt: Aam lines wali grating X-rays ka diffraction dikhane ke liye kyun kaam nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Aam grating ki spacing (taqreeban 10⁻⁶ m) X-ray wavelength (taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m) se das hazar guna bari hai, is liye diffraction ke angles bohat hi chhote hote hain aur naapne ke qabil nahi. Crystal mein atoms ka faasla X-ray wavelength ke order ka hai, is liye crystal grating ka kaam karta hai.

items: X-rays: wavelength taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m; crystal natural grating hai (spacing taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m).
Path difference 2d sin θ; Bragg equation 2d sin θ = nλ (15.8), n = order of reflection.
Istemal: planes ka faasla d; haemoglobin aur DNA ki structure.
